## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this 

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) 
gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct()
gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_site_selected <- breeding_site |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(breeding_site_selected)
```
```{r}
migratory_yay_selected <- migratory_yay|> select( Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat)|>distinct()|> rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude, Stopover_Longitude = pslon, Stopover_Latitude = pslat, Iberian_Longitude = iblon, Iberian_Latitude = iblat, Westmost_Longitude = awestlon, Westmost_Latitude = awestlat )
gt(migratory_yay_selected)
```
```{r}
breeding_dartmoor <- breeding_site_selected |> filter(Site=="Dartmoor")
gt(breeding_dartmoor)
```
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- breeding_site_selected |> filter(Site != "Spain")
bird_migration_exc <- migratory_yay_selected |> filter(Site !="Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```
